children: Bond yields have more room to rise due to multiple unresolved issues, conflicts, and no clear resolution timeline anywhere, ​CIFC Asset Management's Natalia Lojevsky says in a note​. "You have two stresses hitting bond markets around the globe at the same time: a structural supply problem from deficits and massive issuance rates of corporate and sovereign​," the managing director says. That combination, not either one alone, is why we're seeing this move and why it's been relatively aggressive, she says. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
